backend.version: .NET Core 3.1 (netcoreapp3.1), Startup.cs-era; executed via DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD on .NET 10 runtime because the 3.1 runtime is EOL and uninstallable in this environment

auth.notes: ASP.NET Core cookie auth (LegacyShopAuth), demo/demo123; API returns 401 JSON for anonymous protected calls (SPA-era pattern, unlike the mini app's 302). Protected surface: GET /api/orders/history. Okta strangler target (D-004).

build.backend: dotnet (SDK 10 targeting netcoreapp3.1; NETSDK1138 EOL warning expected)
build.frontend: angular-cli 12 (webpack; requires NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider on modern Node)
